fields.label: Rating
fields.text: Initial Influence dots equal Rank and can be divided among domains appropriate to the spirit's nature. One Numen may be exchanged for one Influence dot. Normal Influence ratings cannot exceed Rank; bound Totems have the additional potential described in The Pack p. 63.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse. Influencing thoughts or emotions is contested by the higher of Resolve or Composure, plus Primal Urge.

fields.label: Effect and duration
fields.text: The dots assigned to effect strength plus duration cannot exceed the Influence's rating. Pay the effect's Essence cost plus any duration cost.

fields.label: Duration 0
fields.text: One minute per success; no additional Essence.

fields.label: Duration 1
fields.text: Ten minutes per success; no additional Essence.

fields.label: Duration 2
fields.text: One hour per success; +1 Essence.

fields.label: Duration 3
fields.text: One day per success; +2 Essence.

fields.label: Duration 4
fields.text: Permanent; +2 Essence.

fields.label: Spiritual scent
fields.text: A werewolf who smells the spirit's scent rolls Primal Urge − the spirit's Resistance to identify its highest Influence; exceptional success reveals all of its Influences.

fields.label: Source discrepancy
fields.text: The Influence Effects table on p. 187 explicitly uses Strengthen to change Resonant to Open. The Open prose on p. 189 instead names Control. The catalog preserves the table's mapping and flags the conflicting prose for audit; it does not silently treat them as identical.

fields.label: Initial allocation
fields.text: Spirits begin with Twilight Form and additional Manifestation Effects equal to Rank. Exchange one Numen for one additional Manifestation Effect. Claim requires both Fetter and Possess.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Activate a Manifestation Effect with Power + Finesse, paying its listed cost. Effects crossing the Gauntlet take its dice penalty. Possess, Fetter and Claim against a living target are contested by Resolve + Composure + Primal Urge.

fields.label: Condition prerequisites
fields.text: Conditions belong to a particular spirit. Advancing to a new Condition pauses its prerequisite's duration; it resumes when the advanced Condition ends. Removing a prerequisite also ends the Conditions that depend on it. These are rules references, not automatic state changes.

fields.label: Open
fields.text: Requires Resonant for that spirit. Repeated interaction prepares the subject to accept it: an extended action across a number of scenes equal to Rank, or the living subject's Resolve if higher. Open permits Fetter or Materialize. Removing Resonant ends Open; exorcism can reduce Open to Resonant. See the Influence table discrepancy above.

fields.label: Controlled
fields.text: Requires Open. Repeated Possess use conditions the subject for Claim: a number of separate possessions equal to the higher Willpower of spirit or subject. Ending Possessed early resets this progress. Removing Controlled or Claim forcibly returns the subject to Open.

fields.label: Reaching
fields.text: Opens a conduit through the Gauntlet for one scene. Influences and Numina marked Reaching may operate across it. A Twilight-aware observer can detect the conduit with Wits + Composure.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Activation normally uses Power + Finesse, unless an individual Numen specifies otherwise. Its appearance reflects the spirit's nature. Passive abilities and explicitly roll-free effects are identified separately.

fields.label: Reaching
fields.text: Only Numina marked Reaching can operate across the Gauntlet through the Reaching Manifestation. This does not waive their own costs or resistance.

fields.label: Totem allocation
fields.text: A new Totem starts with one Numen plus one per four Totem points, before exchanges for Influence or Manifestations. The bound Totem's increased potential is a limit, not a free grant of that many powers.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 1 Essence, plus duration costs.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Enhance something in the Influence's domain: improve Defense, intensify an emotion, make animals or plants healthier, or reinforce an object with Rank additional Health or Structure. A Resonant subject may become Open for the duration.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 2 Essence, plus duration costs.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Make minor changes to the domain: alter an emotion's nature or target, an animal's actions, a plant's growth or an object's function.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 3 Essence, plus duration costs.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Make dramatic changes: entirely twist an emotion or dictate animal behavior, plant growth or object function. An Open subject may become Controlled for the duration.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 4 Essence, plus duration costs.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Create a new example of the domain: an emotion, sapling, young animal or object. This can create a temporary Anchor, Infrastructure or Resonant Condition for the chosen duration.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 5 Essence, plus duration costs for multiple temporary creations.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Create Rank examples of the domain, or one permanent example, including a permanent Resonant Condition, without additional duration Essence. This never permanently alters a sapient mind.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: None.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Upon entering the physical world, the spirit appears in Twilight. Spirits begin with this Manifestation Effect for free. Twilight is not physical Materialization and does not allow contact with ordinary material objects.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: None.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Voluntarily disperse as though all Corpus were lost to lethal damage. This painful escape can prevent permanent destruction; normal dormancy and reformation rules still apply.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 1 Essence.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse − the Gauntlet penalty.

fields.label: Duration
fields.text: One scene.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Gain Reaching: open a conduit through the Gauntlet to use Influences and Reaching-marked Numina on its other side. A Twilight-aware observer may notice the conduit with Wits + Composure.

fields.label: Prerequisites
fields.text: Resonant.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 3 Essence.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse − the Gauntlet penalty.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Cross the Gauntlet from the Shadow into the physical world in Twilight, or return to the Shadow.

fields.label: Prerequisites
fields.text: Rank 3+ and Open.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: Essence equal to Gauntlet Strength.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse − the Gauntlet penalty.

fields.label: Duration
fields.text: One scene.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Give the location Shadow Gate: a visible portal between the Shadow and material world, usable by anyone without special powers.

fields.label: Prerequisites
fields.text: Resonant.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 1 Essence.

fields.label: Duration
fields.text: One scene.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Remain in Twilight but become visible to material observers; this does not grant a physical body.

fields.label: Prerequisites
fields.text: Open.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 3 Essence.

fields.label: Duration
fields.text: One hour per success.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Gain Materialized: a physical body within Rank yards of an Open object or person. Materialized spirits are protected from Essence bleed and follow Twilight spirit rules except intangibility. Removing the prerequisite ends Materialized; Bane contact can end it early.

fields.label: Prerequisites
fields.text: Open.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 2 Essence.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse; living targets contest with Resolve + Composure + Primal Urge.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Gain Fettered: attach to a subject in Twilight, stay within five yards and avoid Essence bleed. Influences on the fetter cost one less Essence; neither Influences nor Numina may target anyone else while Fettered. Lasts until its prerequisite is removed or the subject dies or is destroyed, unless temporarily suppressed with Unfetter. A living subject also becomes Urged.

fields.label: Urged
fields.text: Read surface thoughts with Power + Finesse contested by Resolve + Primal Urge; urge an action with Power + Finesse contested by Resolve + Composure. Following an urge rewards a Beat, resolved manually. Urged ends with Fettered.

fields.label: Prerequisites
fields.text: Fettered.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 1 Essence.

fields.label: Duration
fields.text: One scene.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Temporarily suppress Fettered, allowing movement and other Manifestations. At scene's end these Manifestations also end. If not back within five yards of the fetter, immediately enter dormancy.

fields.label: Prerequisites
fields.text: Open.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 3 Essence.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse; living targets contest with Resolve + Composure + Primal Urge.

fields.label: Duration
fields.text: One scene, or until the spirit leaves or the host dies or is destroyed.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Give a subject Possessed: control an object, corpse or living host. A living host becomes comatose, with missing time and possible flashbacks. The spirit is protected from Essence bleed but cannot use Numina or Influences while controlling the host. Spend one Essence per turn to heal one bashing/lethal wound or Structure damage; a corpse that died through damage begins incapacitated.

fields.label: Host traits
fields.text: Objects retain their normal functions; use the spirit's Finesse for necessary rolls. A corpse or other articulated host uses its Physical Attributes and the spirit's Mental/Social Attributes; spend one Essence to use the spirit's Physical Attributes for one turn, causing one lethal wound or Structure damage. Living hosts always use their own Attributes. Read their minds at Finesse −4; use their Physical Skills at −3 and Mental/Social Skills at −4, reduced by one per day spent Fettered to that host.

fields.label: Ending possession
fields.text: The spirit overlays the host in Twilight. Bane contact or a Bane weapon damages its Corpus; abjuration, exorcism, its Ban or Bane can force it to leave.

fields.label: Prerequisites
fields.text: Controlled; the spirit must also possess Fetter and Possess.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 5 Essence.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse; living targets contest with Resolve + Composure + Primal Urge.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Give the host Claimed: permanently merge over several days. A living host stays conscious and Urged during fusion. From the first day, add one spirit Attribute dot per day to an appropriate host Attribute. Corpses have Mental/Social Attributes 0; objects have Dexterity, Mental and Social Attributes 0, with Structure/Durability replacing physical measures. Nonliving hosts are not Urged.

fields.label: Claimed hybrid
fields.text: Use Influences, not Numina or Manifestation Effects. New Dread Powers may develop under the separate antagonist rules. The hybrid has the spirit's Essence, Ban and Bane, is protected from Essence bleed from the start, and may cross the Gauntlet at a locus with Intelligence + Presence.

fields.label: Leaving a living host
fields.text: Roll original Power + Finesse − Rank contested by the host's Resolve + Composure, including added dots. If successful, the body reverses its changes at the rate they developed; added Attributes fall by two dots per day. Essence and Dread Powers vanish immediately.

fields.label: Nonliving host
fields.text: After full fusion, lose one Physical Attribute dot or object equivalent every three days. When any reaches zero, the host disintegrates and the spirit returns to Twilight.

fields.label: Prerequisites
fields.text: The spirit must be in a Condition that allows it to speak to the victim.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 7 Essence.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse contested by Resolve + Composure + Primal Urge.

fields.label: Duration
fields.text: Days equal to the victim's Willpower.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Plant an idea that becomes an insistent earworm and spreads through retelling. Victims are not compelled to act on it.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 3 Essence.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse; each observer contests with Presence + Composure + Primal Urge.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Anyone who sees the spirit and rolls fewer successes cannot move or speak for one turn; an exceptional success extends this to three turns.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse, as a firearm attack.

fields.label: Range
fields.text: Power × 10 yards, without range penalties.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Project a lethal attack with weapon rating 0L. Spend two Essence per additional +1L, up to Rank in additional damage. No initial Essence cost is printed.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 1 Essence.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse contested by Intelligence + Primal Urge.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Inflict Madness for the remainder of the scene.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse contested by Stamina + Resolve + Primal Urge.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Choose Essence or Willpower from a material target. Whichever party rolls more successes gains that many points of the chosen resource and the other loses them: the attack can backfire. No Essence cost is printed.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 1 Essence.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse, rolled once; entrants contest with Resolve + Composure + Primal Urge.

fields.label: Range
fields.text: Five-yard aura.

fields.label: Duration
fields.text: One scene, or until the spirit uses another Numen.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Radiate an emotion. If the spirit wins, the victim takes −2 on all actions while the aura remains. If the victim wins, they are immune until the spirit activates it again.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 3 Essence.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse, resisted by Stamina for living targets, Resistance for spirits or Durability for objects.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Accelerate destruction, rot or corrosion. Each success inflicts one lethal damage.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 1 Essence.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Start one small fire per success on flammable material within Power yards.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Sense ghosts in Twilight and consume their Essence as though they were spirits. This rare ability usually belongs to spirits of death or grief. The entry gives no separate activation cost or roll; use normal Essence feeding and stealing rules.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 1 Essence.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse contested by Wits + Composure + Primal Urge.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Make one target experience an illusion of anything the spirit wishes, including conversation. The entry does not specify duration.

fields.label: Prerequisites
fields.text: Currently Possessing or Claiming a host; the host touches a new subject meeting all prerequisites for that Manifestation.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 3 Essence; do not pay the Manifestation's cost again.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Immediately transfer Possessed or Claimed to the new subject. Claim fusion begins again; a vacated living host suffers the normal aftereffects.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 2 Essence.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Give a mortal a vision of a task and the Obsessed Condition concerning it.

fields.label: Activation
fields.text: No roll or Essence expenditure.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Blend into the surroundings. Perception rolls to notice the spirit take −2.

fields.label: Prerequisites
fields.text: A human-made device with at least three moving parts. Touch it while Manifest, or overlap it in Twilight. In combat, gain control of it in a grapple; Twilight cannot do so unless the device is also in Twilight.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 1 Essence.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: The device malfunctions for turns equal to successes.

fields.label: Prerequisites
fields.text: Materialized; may activate alongside Materialize.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 1 Essence.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse.

fields.label: Duration
fields.text: Hours equal to successes.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Appear human. Observers may notice something wrong with Wits + Composure − Finesse; observers able to perceive the spirit in Twilight ignore this penalty.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 1 Essence for the spirit, or 3 to grant the vision to someone else.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse; usable once per 24 hours.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Foresee an event within the next week. The vision tends toward danger.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 1 Essence.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse; a Safe Place contests with the lowest Resolve + Primal Urge among its owners.

fields.label: Duration
fields.text: One scene; activate again if the trip takes longer.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Reveal the fastest route to a destination, not necessarily the safest. It does not reveal dangers along the way.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 2 Essence.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Success inflicts Stunned. The victim then rolls Resolve + Primal Urge; failure causes a temporary derangement aligned with the spirit's wishes for Power days. Werewolves omit Primal Urge when resisting a Lune. The source says derangement, not a named Madness Condition.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 1 Essence.

fields.label: Activation
fields.text: No roll; reactivate each turn to heal further wounds.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Heal one bashing or lethal Corpus wound, bashing first. This does not heal aggravated damage.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Finesse.

fields.label: Range
fields.text: Two miles per Rank; spend one Essence to multiply the range by ten.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Find the direction and distance to the nearest suitable Resonant Condition.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 2 Essence to double Speed, or 4 to triple it.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse.

fields.label: Duration
fields.text: One scene.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 1 Essence.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Produce a single message or image in any medium, such as condensation, screens or phones.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Use Resistance as Defense instead of Power or Finesse. The spirit appears armored. The entry specifies no activation cost or roll; it does not grant an Armor rating.

fields.label: Cost
fields.text: 1 Essence.

fields.label: Dice Pool
fields.text: Power + Finesse.

fields.label: Effect
fields.text: Use successes as Strength to lift or throw objects without Materializing. This does not permit fine motor control.
